Agent Name: WebSurfer
 Step Number: 8
 Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly recorded Walter West’s birth year as 1913 despite the visible authoritative sources (Wikipedia and IMDb) showing 1885. This unverified, contradictory value introduced a false ambiguity and could directly lead to the wrong conclusion (favoring Santa Fe Uprising instead of the correct Trainer And Temptress).
